candidate.selection_reason: Inserts a hidden field with the device's user ID into the delete form, which is later used in the success URL without validation, enabling potential tampering.
candidate.source_summary: The user_id value comes from object.user.id in the template context, representing the device owner's ID
candidate.sink_summary: The user_id POST parameter is used directly in DeviceDeleteView.get_success_url() to construct a redirect URL without validation
candidate.guard_summary: No validation of the user_id parameter in get_success_url(); uses self.request.POST.get('user_id') directly
candidate.risk_pattern: Hidden form field value flows directly into URL construction without validation, enabling potential redirect manipulation
candidate.context_summary: Template inserts hidden user_id field in device deletion confirmation form; the view uses this POST parameter to construct redirect URL
unresolved_facts: Whether DeviceDeleteView has authentication/authorization decorators applied
Whether the redirect URL undergoes any safety validation
Whether the user_id parameter is validated against the authenticated user's permissions

target_cwe.description: The web application does not adequately enforce appropriate authorization on all restricted URLs, scripts, or files.
remediation_steps: Implement proper authentication and session management

stage3_hypothesis.fit_reason: User-controlled user_id parameter could enable unauthorized access to other users' device lists via forced browsing
